title: A Time-Lapse Map of Every Nuclear Explosion Since 1945 - by  Isao Hashimoto
summary: Isao Hashimoto's time-lapse map shows all 2053 nuclear explosions between 1945 and 1998, with each nation getting a blip and a running tally. Each second represents one month.
why: Used as a striking visualization of the sheer scale and rhythm of nuclear testing, and as a model for conveying scale with a counter.

quote.text: It really puts into perspective just how many nukes have gone off for purposes other than to kill people.
